question: True or false: twenty heartfelt patient testimonials are good evidence that a treatment works?
answer: False. Testimonials come only from people who improved and chose to speak; nobody counts those who got worse, stayed the same or would have recovered anyway. A clinic with thousands of patients can fill a wall with true stories while helping no one. The missing number is how many tried it in all.
move: Ask how many tried it before counting how many praise it.
ask: When glowing reviews sell me something, do I wonder how many people tried it and stayed silent?
trap: True, since twenty real people cannot all be mistaken.
